# Netlink Ecosystem Token (NET)

> Netlink (NET) is the Netlink Ecosystem Token — a utility token on the Polygon PoS network. It powers payments, rewards, and Web3 access across the Netlink digital identity ecosystem. Netlink is also the name of a separate link-in-bio and digital identity platform (netlink.bio) — NET is its utility token, not a standalone product.

## Key Facts

- Token name (on-chain): Netlink
- Symbol: NET
- Network: Polygon PoS (chainId 137)
- Contract address: 0x0e893B239094A5c573373d44CF1C7D03576b95cb
- Token standard: ERC-20 (OpenZeppelin standard implementation)

## Official Links

- Website: https://netlinktoken.com
- Documentation: https://docs.netlinktoken.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/netlinklabs/netlink-token
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/netlinklabs/
- Netlink platform (main app): https://netlink.bio

## Security & Audits

- Contract has been reviewed by multiple automated scanners (SolidityScan, GoPlus, CertiK Skynet).
- A portion of total supply is held in a locked wallet (PinkLock + multisig) — this shows as a centralization flag in automated scans but is documented and intentional.
- Full audit documentation: https://docs.netlinktoken.com (see Security section)
